tips.text: This project is NOT Mathlib4. Lemma names differ. Always use lean_local_search before guessing.
Proofs >30 lines must be decomposed into helper lemmas (each ≤15 lines). Write them BEFORE the main theorem.
lean_diagnostic_messages with timeout_s=30 after EVERY edit. partial:true means still elaborating — poll again.
Max 1-3 lines per edit. Check errors after each edit. If errors increase, revert immediately.
Tactic order: rfl → simp → norm_num → linarith → nlinarith → omega → exact → apply → rw → have → calc
LebesgueOuterMeasure.of_Icc a b gives measure of preimage of [a,b] as b-a. Use Real.equiv_EuclideanSpace' to embed ℝ.
BoundedInterval with IsClosed.toSet is Icc a b or empty, by closed_eq_Icc_or_empty.
LebesgueMeasure.countable_union gives m(⋃ E_n) = ∑' m(E_n) for measurable disjoint E_n.

successes.tactics: BaireSpace.baire_property, IsClosed.sdiff, IsComplete.completeSpace_coe, exists_surjective_nat, interior_eq_empty_iff_dense_compl, Set.countable_iUnion
successes.description: [0,1) is not a countable disjoint union of closed intervals: Baire on endpoint set K=[0,1]\⋃Ioo; isolated point x>0 gives gap contradiction; if x=0 isolated, zoom to K∩[ε₁,1] and reapply Baire

successes.tactics: unfold, le_antisymm, linear_bound, Matrix.linear_equiv_det, det_comp, det_id, abs_mul, abs_one, mul_assoc, norm_cast, Set.image_image
successes.description: Change-of-variables formula: measure scales by |det A|. Upper bound via linear_bound, lower bound via linear_bound on T.symm and det(T)*det(T.symm)=1.
Proved product outer measure ≤ ε when one factor has measure 0, using box covers and the key real inequality

successes.tactics: adapted prod_null_right proof with d₁/d₂ swapped
successes.description: Symmetric version of prod_null_right for when the other factor has measure 0

errors.message: Lemma sInf_image2_mul_eq_mul_sInf is false. Counterexample: A positive reals approaching 0, B = {infinity}. sInf A * sInf B = 0*infinity = 0 but sInf {a*infinity | a in A} = sInf {infinity} = infinity.
errors.solution: --solution Add condition that sets are subsets of R (no infinite values), or that 0 in A whenever sInf A = 0 and infinity in B.
